items.name: Record order backlog of NOK 158 billion, Q2 2026
items.claim: KONGSBERG secured new orders valued at NOK 17 billion during the quarter, resulting in a record-high order backlog of NOK 158 billion.
items.source_excerpt: Business activity remained high, and during the quarter we secured new orders valued at NOK 17 billion, resulting in a record-high order backlog of NOK 158 billion.

items.name: Raytheon agreement for NASAMS delivery to Kuwait
items.claim: During the quarter, KONGSBERG also announced a significant agreement with Raytheon for the delivery of NASAMS air defence systems to Kuwait.
items.source_excerpt: During the quarter, we also announced a significant agreement with Raytheon for the delivery of NASAMS air defence systems to Kuwait.

items.name: Canada selects Joint Strike Missile (JSM), sixth nation
items.claim: Per KONGSBERG's CEO commentary on the quarter, JSM activity was particularly strong, with increased sales to the United States and Germany, and Canada became the sixth nation to select the missile.
items.source_excerpt: Activity related to the Joint Strike Missile (JSM) was particularly strong, with increased sales to the United States and Germany, while Canada became the sixth nation to select the JSM.

items.name: Acquisition of Zone 5 Technologies completed 9 June 2026
items.claim: The acquisition of Zone 5 Technologies, which KONGSBERG completed on 9 June, complements its product portfolio, spanning from highly advanced missile systems to products designed for high-volume production.
items.source_excerpt: The acquisition of Zone 5 Technologies, completed on 9 June, complements our product portfolio. It provides KONGSBERG with a range of solutions spanning from highly advanced missile systems to products designed for high-volume production.

items.name: Canada selects 212CD submarine, KONGSBERG a key supplier
items.claim: Per KONGSBERG's CEO commentary on the quarter, Canada's selection of the 212CD submarine names KONGSBERG as a key supplier.
items.source_excerpt: One example is Canada’s selection of the 212CD submarine, where KONGSBERG is a key supplier.
